cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: A brightly fluorescent modern indoor skating rink concession counter — She buys a small cup of shaved ice after her first lap in years and waits as the color settles across it; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — lying on her front; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; her living room with a deep sofa — tears a finished page out of a notebook; a starship galley and mess hall — pours tea from a small teapot into a cup on the table; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; A modern apartment reading nook at night — She reaches for the little prism at the end of a chapter and splashes a rectangle of lamplight across the wall; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — perched on a ledge or edge; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — sitting on the ground; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; the inside of a quiet subway car — standing; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — crouching low on her heels
